final_message:
I parsed the log file `workspace/app.log` to extract entries with levels of ERROR or CRITICAL. Each relevant entry was processed to extract the timestamp, service name, error level (in uppercase), message, exception (if present), and repeat count. The repeat count was calculated based on the occurrences of the message in the log.

The structured output was saved in `workspace/errors.json`, which includes an array of error objects and a summary of counts by service. The JSON file adheres to the specified format and Acme's log-triage conventions.
